}}'''Moby-Duck''' is a {{Rare}} item that grants {{stat|Fishing Wisdom}}. After reaching {{Green|30}} bonus {{Stat|Fishing Wisdom}}, it evolves into a '''Moby-Duck: Collector's Edition'''.

== Obtaining ==
'''Moby-Duck''' can be obtained as an {{RMCT|&d&lOUTSTANDING &2&lJUNK &d&lCATCH}} by fishing with a {{Item|Junk Sinker}} applied to a [[Fishing Rod]].

== Usage ==
Upon reaching {{Green|30}} bonus {{Stat|Fishing Wisdom}}, the '''Moby-Duck''' evolves into a '''Moby-Duck: Collector's Edition''' with the following message.

{{Dialogue|&d&lEVOLUTION! &dYour &5Moby-Duck &dhas evolved!}}

A '''Moby-Duck''' gains {{stat|fishing wisdom|0.1}} every hour of the player being online, taking 300 hours to reach the maximum buff of {{stat|fishing wisdom|30}}. {{Aging Items Process}}

Using a '''Moby-Duck: Collector's Edition''' grants {{statname|fishing wisdom|30}}, as well a permanent {{stat|fishing wisdom|+1}}. This can only be done once.

== Trivia ==
*'''Moby-Duck''' is a reference to the popular 1851 novel [[w:Moby-Dick|''Moby-Dick'']].
**Likewise, {{NPCSprite|Captain Baha}} is a reference to a major character in ''Moby-Dick'', Captain Ahab.
*'''Moby-Duck''' is the only [[Aging Item]] whose permanent bonus is only granted once.
